chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
How strange! Could the caliphate be through the companionship but not through the companionship and the kinship?

key_terms.الصَّحَابَة: Companionship (being a companion of the Prophet)
key_terms.الْقَرَابَة: Kinship (family relationship, specifically with the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of kinship in the legitimacy of the caliphate according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi records this rhetorical question to critique the Sunni selection process, contrasting 'al-Ṣaḥābah' (general companions) with 'al-Ṣaḥābah wa-l-Qarābah' (companionship combined with kinship). This distinction underscores the Shia doctrine that legitimate leadership (Imamate) requires both proximity to the Prophet and his specific lineage, a concept central to the event of Ghadir Khumm.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 190. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
How strange? Could the caliphate be through the (Prophet’s) companionship but not through (his) companionship and (his) kinship?
